Paragraph: "This fire of grief born out of the throes of love, and furthered by the attributes of spring season will swiftly burn me down in no time...
Situation/Problem_Faced: The combination of love-longing and spring attributes threatens to destroy Rama's emotional resilience.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama warns Lakshmana of the overwhelming intensity of his grief.
Outcome/Resolution: He articulates the urgency and severity of his mental distress.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shokagni (The fire of grief born out of love throes)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sorrow born of pure love (Shokagni) is viewed as an all-consuming fire that tests the extreme limits of human and divine endurance.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Expressing severe psychological distress wherein grief acts as an escalating internal threat, overwhelming the individual's mental coping capacity.
